Suresh

Email - k96suresh@gmail.com

Phone Number - 9985352989

Working as a Senior Team Member with 5 Years of experience in Hybrid and fund accounting and Private Equity. A result-oriented associate with expertise in Fund Accounting, Reporting and operations aimed at enhancing overall organizational growth and improved business performance.

Key Skills

 Finance and Accounts  Private Equity, Fund Accounting and Reporting  Basic Programmes: Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc), Outlook  Geneva, Investran, Report wizard, SDX,IRIS, Arcesium, Fairx, TLM , Cascade, and MCH etc.,

Career Scan

JP Morgan and Chase BBusiness Skills

since July ’2022 to till now

As a Senior Team Member  Experienced on end-to-end cash and position reconciliation between custody vs accounting

and matching breaks. Route causing breaks investigation and resolving

 Working on Capital Events and working with TA team for Pcaps to Generate and to release to

Investors.

 Working on non-trading accruals monthly and quarter to matching with Budgets and payments  Booking and Calculating Management fees and Carry Quarterly and Monthly  Working on IM Reconciliation between client and internal to matching qty, interest cost and MV  Working on Investran and Report Wizard accounting tools.  Working on the GAV and NAV Packs for Quarterly and Monthly  Working on client pricing files and pricing and calculating LP pricing based on blockers GAV.  Work on Monthly Project light (Maintain shareholder register) and Money market Report and validating

on position

 Work on the monthly cash reconciliation with external Bank statement and with Broker or Custodian.  Work on special and ad hoc projects for clients and internally with meeting SLAs.  Anticipate, proactively communicate, and escalate issues to fund managers and the client in a

timely fashion.

 Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle activities for Hedge Funds and Mutual Funds, ensuring timely

processing from trade execution through settlement and reconciliation.

 Monitored trade lifecycle events and resolved exceptions to ensure accurate accounting and successful settlement.  Coordinated with Middle Office, Custodian, and Fund Accounting teams to ensure seamless trade processing and NAV

delivery.

 Validated trade details captured from front-office systems and verified trade attributes including security, quantity, price,

settlement date, and counterparty details.

 Performed trade enrichment and validation by reconciling trade feeds against broker and custodian confirmations.

Supported daily trade settlement activities across Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Mutual Fund transactions.

 Reconciled trade settlement instructions with custodians and brokers to ensure timely settlement and minimize



settlement failures. Investigated settlement breaks, collaborated with internal teams and counterparties, and ensured timely resolution of exceptions.

 Performed cash and position reconciliations post-settlement to ensure accurate fund accounting and NAV calculation.   NAV calculation finalization and validating all financial reports TB, PNL checks, Pricing, Closing and opening

Investigated and resolved trade capture discrepancies to ensure accurate downstream processing.

balances and capital movements etc.,

 Worked on Corporate Actions impacting securities positions and NAV calculations.  Performed cash, position, and security reconciliations to identify and resolve breaks.  Utilized Geneva, TLM, Bloomberg, and MS Excel to support trade processing, reconciliation, and fund accounting activities.

 Supported daily NAV production by validating trade activity, corporate actions, pricing, and accruals before NAV release.  Signing off the GAV and NAV for client approval once internal check and review is done.

State Street Corporation

since June ’2021 to Jan ’2022

Business Skills As a Associate 2

 Booking the daily Journal entries in accounting application, reconciliations of quarterly or Monthly for

reports.

 Working on Investran and Report Wizard accounting tools.  Working on Quarterly templates or reports  Reconciliation of Net Asset Value (Partner Capital Account Statements (PCAP)  Booking monthly FX memo commitment adjustments on every month beginning.  Reconciliation of Capital Account Statements and recording quarterly Mark to Market adjustments.  Creation of new deals in the system through client request and saving the all-legal documents.  Taking Ireland clients & US calls to answer their queries if any on timely manner.  Anticipate, proactively communicate and escalate issues to fund manager and the client in a timely fashion.  Reconciliation of Investor Bank Statement in every month  Working on monthly Roll-Forward reports  Preparing and updating MIS /Dashboard reports and Prepared SOPs for funds

State Street HCL Services

since August 2018 to Apr 2020

As as Analyst:

 Worked on AIS Hedge Fund Accounting and End-to-End NAV Team  Experienced on end to end cash and Position recon process custodian and prime broker vs client  Worked on Non-trading accruals and booking all expenses and fees into GENEVA.  Preparing investor allocations of the fund and preparing investor Transferency reports sending to on shore team

and preparing for client files sending to onshore.

 Experienced on corporate actions and IM recon and on pricing  Worked on Capital activities, allocations bookings and sending to TA team for PCAPS and preparing checklist

sing off sending to onshore and client for approvals.

 Calculating the carry interest and booking investor level at fund wise.  Calculating the management fees and booking sending for client approvals.

Key Deliverables:

 Ensure team responds to ad hoc reporting in a timely manner

PPersonal Skills

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 Willingness to learn new things & to take new challenges.

 More patience & Positive attitude.

 Good team player.

Education

 Master’s Degree

: MBA(FINANCE) from Accord Business School in the year 2018..
